subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should OpenClaw add and permanently support `openclaw tui --agent <id>` as a public startup-routing contract, rather than relying on agent-scoped session keys and workspace inference?
rationale: The existing paths cover some workflows, but choosing a dedicated CLI alias and defining its durable precedence with session keys and workspace inference is product and compatibility policy, not a purely mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Sponsor the explicit selector
options.body: Add a validated `--agent <id>` option with documented precedence and focused TUI routing coverage.

options.title: Keep the current routing model
options.body: Retain workspace inference and agent-scoped session keys as the supported startup mechanisms and close this request only after that policy is stated clearly.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the explicit selector
recommendation.body: Add a validated `--agent <id>` option with documented precedence and focused TUI routing coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent TUI routing history and the prior review of this exact gap make this the strongest available product-routing contact.
